about: Le righe di soli stili (`classDef`, `class`, `style`, `linkStyle`, `click`) e una classe `:::` non si tengono: note line_skipped e style_dropped. Una riga che non si capisce si salta con una nota, e il resto vale.

op.text:
flowchart LR
  classDef caldo fill:#f96
  A[Sole]:::caldo --> B[Mare]
  class B caldo
  style A stroke:#333
  linkStyle 0 stroke:red
  click A "https://example.com"
  questa riga non è mermaid ]]

notes.detail: line 2: `classDef caldo fill:#f96` sets a style, which a canvas does not keep
line 3: the class of "A" is a style, which a canvas does not keep
line 4: `class B caldo` sets a style, which a canvas does not keep
line 5: `style A stroke:#333` sets a style, which a canvas does not keep
line 6: `linkStyle 0 stroke:red` sets a style, which a canvas does not keep
line 7: `click A "https://example.com"` sets an action on click, which a canvas does not keep
line 8: `questa riga non è mermaid ]]` is not understood
